notes: Edited existing stories to tighten contracts, orchestration behavior, and test scope. No new IDs created.

change_log.value: Define unified Pydantic request/response contract with operation enum (clinical_trials_search, provider_detail), normalized inputs, and a consistent response envelope (status, data, errors, metadata, trace_id, latency_ms) supporting forward-compatible extensions.

Implement deterministic routing, aggregation, normalization, retries/timeouts for downstream calls, and error standardization across clinical_trials_service and provider_detail_service with consistent envelope output and graceful degradation on partial failures.
Expose facade through tool_router with strict Pydantic validation, operation dispatch, allowlist enforcement (GOV-004), and compatibility with Anthropic tool-use loop including trace_id propagation.

Validate multi-service aggregation scenarios ensuring consistent schema output when combining clinical trials and provider detail data, including partial response stitching, precedence rules, null-handling, and deterministic ordering.

Implement unit and integration tests covering schema validation, routing logic, retries/timeouts, error handling, aggregation rules, and full tool_router execution paths for both clinical trials search and provider detail flows.
change_log.note: Expand test coverage to resiliency and aggregation
